source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the receptors of taste (PDF 44).

blocks.text: Zaiqa khaas chemoreceptors, taste buds, mehsoos karte hain. Yeh taqreeban 10,000 hain, zyada tar zaban ke ubharon (papillae) ke darmiyan, kuch gale mein aur munh ki chhat par. Taste bud piyaz-numa hai, baal jaise siron wale receptor cells aur naye receptor cells banane wale basal cells se bana, aur taste pore se munh mein khulta hai.

blocks.alt: Zaban aur us par kadwe (bitter, peeche), khatte (sour, kinare), namkeen (salty) aur meethe (sweet, nok) ke hisse. Dabbe mein ghiri papilla se teer papilla ke bare tukre tak jata hai jis ki deewaron mein taste buds hain; doosra teer bare taste bud tak: receptor cells jin ke baal taste pore par khulte hain, basal cells, aur neeche se nikalte sensory neurons ke axons, sab zaban ke epithelium mein.

blocks.text: Jab khane ya peene ki cheez ke kimiyai madde receptor cells ko jagate hain to woh sensory neurons mein impulses banate hain jo cranial nerves VII, IX aur X ke zariye brainstem aur phir cerebral cortex ke zaiqe wale hisson tak jate hain. Cortex ise boo aur banawat jaisi doosri maloomat ke saath mila kar zaiqe ka poora ehsas banata hai.

Insan paanch bunyadi zaiqe mehsoos karta hai: namkeen, meetha, khatta, kadwa aur umami (gosht jaisa namkeen-lazeez zaiqa). Zaban ke har hisse ke taste buds mein har bunyadi zaiqe ke receptor cells hote hain; kisi hisse mein sirf aik zaiqe ke taste buds nahi hote, sirf hasasiyat mein thora farq hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke insan mein chaar qism ke taste buds hain jo zaban ke alag hisson mein ziyada hain: meetha nok par, khatta kinaron par, kadwa peeche aur namkeen zyada tar sateh par ('zaban ka naqsha'). Yeh purana aur ghalat khayal hai: zaban ke har hisse ke taste buds mein har bunyadi zaiqe ke receptor cells hain, aur umami paanchwan bunyadi zaiqa hai.

blocks.title: Aazma kar dekhiye
blocks.text: Boo zaiqe par asar karti hai: piyaz ka tukra pehle naak khuli rakh kar aur phir naak band kar ke khaiye aur farq dekhiye.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi cranial nerves zaiqe ke impulses brainstem tak le jati hain?
blocks.explanation: Cranial nerves VII, IX aur X.

items: Taqreeban 10,000 taste buds (receptor cells, basal cells, taste pore); impulses nerves VII, IX, X se brainstem aur cortex tak; boo zaiqe mein izafa karti hai.
